_note: Site objects in the house folk art look (John, 16 Oct 2026): characters and scene pieces for the pages, made as pictures and cut out of their white paper (no background). Run with generate_mockups.py --config scripts/catalog/site-objects.json --theme site --stage art. Small icons are vector files in art/, not made here.
style: A single small character or object for a children's website, in the Telning house look: a flat 2D naive folk art children's book illustration in a mid-century Scandinavian style. Art style and technique: Scandinavian mid-century folk art style. Gouache painting texture, dry-brush acrylic strokes, and visible colored pencil grain. Simple, bold, geometric shapes with clear simple silhouettes and sharp pointed features, about 20% more curved than strict geometry; animals have wide perfectly round wide-open eyes with dark pupils; a few fine folk patterns (dots, dashes, tiny leaves) on the shapes; bold freehand brush lines, never thin, nothing drawn with a ruler. Colours: burnt orange, mustard yellow, deep teal, matte black and cream. It must read clearly when shown small (about 60 pixels): a few big shapes and strong contrast. Strictly avoid: soft vector clipart, 3D shading, gradients, rounded plush shapes, glossy textures.
no_text: No text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no border, no frame.
